Let us learn about computer networks.
A computer network is a system of connected devices that communicate
[pause 1.1]
with two shared data, hardware resource and services over wired or wireless links.
type of computer networks are
[pause 4.0]
PAN, Personal Area Network, connects personal devices like phones, laptops within a short range of about 10 meters.
LAN, local area network links computers within a single room.
office building or school.
Man, Metropolitan Area Network covers a larger area like a town or a city.
when wide area network connects computers across large physical distances, countries or the whole globe such as the internet.
The key components are
first nodes
These are the devices attached to a network including end devices.
computers and smartphone printers and intermediary devices like routers and switches.
Second, transmission media, physical cables like fiber optics, twisted pair or wireless signals like Wi-Fi or radio waves that carry data.
protocols set of rules that dictate how data is formatted transmitted and received

Let us learn about microcontroller.
[pause 2.0]
A microcontroller or MCU is a small computer on a single integrated circuit that is designed to control specific tasks with electronic systems. It combines the functions of Central Processing Unit CPU.
